_comment: v1.13.1 - the second Hirtius batch: the remaining nine of De Bello Gallico VIII, which closes the book at its allocated 20. The Bellovaci campaign finished (19, 22), the strategic assessment and the ruin of Ambiorix's country (24), the memory of Alesia at the last siege (34), the fire barrels and the spring (42, 43), and the political year in full (49, 50, 54) leading into the two legions of 55. All nine are whole chapters. NOTE: adding 43 means shrinking the closing note of 41, which had been summarising it - the removal condition recorded in check_context.js, exactly as for BC II.28.
bg.8.19: elatos iracundia victores in se tela conicere.
bg.8.24: propter tantas calamitates haberet in civitatem.
bg.8.34: plurimis in locis infirma disponat praesidia.
